name: @zhhoceanfly/protoview-dbx
description: ApiMan (ProtoView) as a DBX (.dbxp) plugin; requires Node.js >= 18 on PATH

scripts.package: npm run build && npx --yes @dbx-app/plugin-cli package . --output-dir dist && npm run package:normalize
scripts.dev: node ../../scripts/check-node-for-dbx-dev.js && npm run build && npx --yes @dbx-app/plugin-cli dev --path . --port 5190
